query: Improve regional composition, readable measures, whitespace and wide/narrow staging without prescribing a page genre

policy.noReferenceFallback: Use subject, local evidence, and authored direction; do not invent a skin from the catalog.

sections.label: Navigation and entry
sections.prompt: Does the entry structure establish the product and invite the right first action?
sections.decision: Keep identity and entry compact; let the start edge and the primary object establish the first datum, then attach utilities to their local region.

sections.label: First viewport
sections.prompt: What leads the eye, what is dominant, and what peeks into the next chapter?
sections.decision: Separate the viewport field, object stage, title measure, and action placement; the opening may center the subject while copy uses another local edge.

sections.label: Object or content
sections.prompt: How is the actual subject, artifact, data, or workflow made visible?
sections.decision: Let each actual object keep its natural measure and crop; a wide painting, portrait work, and near-square water image do not share one media ratio.

sections.label: Composition and rhythm
sections.prompt: Which alignment, scale, spacing, crop, and counterweight relationships create the silhouette?
sections.decision: Use changing reading distance as the rhythm: centered orientation, bounded instrument, close field note, then a compact source record.

sections.label: Responsive re-staging
sections.prompt: What changes on narrow screens, touch input, and long content?
sections.decision: At intermediate and narrow widths, regroup the relationship and preserve the artwork or subject before shrinking type; mobile can change order and alignment.

sections.label: States and interaction
sections.prompt: How do controls, feedback, empty/error/success states, and recovery read?
sections.decision: Keep source switching, reduced-motion, and media failure in the same hierarchy as the ready state; the changed result stays close to its controls.

sections.label: Motion language
sections.prompt: Which changes need motion, and what are the cleanup, reduced-motion, and static final states?
sections.decision: Use motion only for state continuity or inspection; the final reading state and fallback remain complete without travel or looping.

sections.label: Assets and material
sections.prompt: Which image, video, texture, type, color, and surface choices carry the subject?
sections.decision: Use real, attributable painting assets and preserve their natural subject scale; material and crop carry identity before decorative effects.

sections.label: Ending and continuation
sections.prompt: How does the surface resolve, hand off, or make the next action legible?
sections.decision: End with a compact return to the collection and source records; a short page does not need invented cards or a stretched final band.

synthesis.direction: Content-led regional composition with local alignment decisions and explicit responsive re-staging
synthesis.visualLanguage: Use the subject, material, and reading path to author the surface; open field, soft contour, measured contrast, and one repeatable index or caption device are available, but no universal skin is required.
synthesis.composition: Separate viewport field, content shell, object stage, and reading measure. Choose placement and text alignment per actual region. Let centered overview, start-aligned prose, end-attached utility, and asymmetric object relationships coexist when their neighbors justify them. Wide screens grow fields before prose; intermediate widths regroup; narrow screens change order and crop.
synthesis.type: One readable UI/body family plus an earned display or data role; set type ceiling by content and viewing distance, and inspect line endings with real copy.
synthesis.material: Use user-owned, official, attributable, or deliberately generated subject media. Let crop, tone, texture, and object scale carry identity before effects; no placeholders or weak filler.
synthesis.motion: Review each state relationship, apply the lightest local mechanism, then polish cleanup, interruption, reduced-motion, and static final state. Static is valid when motion has no job.
synthesis.assets: Preserve real assets and provenance; when a visual thesis is unresolved, use image generation as a proposal and translate the selected delta into usable code and assets before acceptance.
synthesis.templateRisk: The main risk is turning local examples into a fixed template: no site-wide alignment axis, no repeated 50/50 splits, no filler sections, no default commerce or dashboard genre, and no component catalog skin without a named job.
gaps: Fresh browser authentication is unavailable in this session; future briefs still need their own live reference inspection and rendered proof.

selected.reason: Use the internal adapter for Review -> Apply -> Polish; keep cleanup, reduced-motion, and static fallback without asking the user to install the upstream skill.
